issues.title: Event date rule says 'after TRTSDT' but events on TRTSDT are used
issues.summary: Define-XML ADTTE.ADT takes ADAE.ASTDT only when it falls after TRTSDT; the specification has no date test, and the reference uses same-day events as the event date.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.ADT: if ADAE.ASTDT is not missing and occurred after TRTSDT then ADAE.ASTDT, else convert ADSL.RFENDTC to a SAS numeric date.
issues.observed: Run as written, the rule differs from the reference ADT on 5 of 254 records; taking the first flagged dermatologic event date with no TRTSDT test, as Pilot 6 adtte.r does, reproduces all 254.
issues.action: Decide whether an event starting on TRTSDT counts; then either change the Define-XML comment to 'on or after TRTSDT' or add the strict date test to the specification.

citations.quote: if ADAE.ASTDT is not missing and occurred after TRTSDT then ADAE.ASTDT else convert ADSL.RFENDTC to a SAS numeric date

Since ADAE is a source for ADTTE, the first chronological occurrence based on the start dates (and sequence numbers) of the treatment emergent dermatological events are flagged (AOCC01FL) to facilitate traceability between these two analysis datasets.

issues.title: SAP end-of-study definition has no counterpart in the censoring date
issues.summary: SAP page 10 defines end of study as the Week 26 or early termination visit; the ADT specification censors at ADSL.RFENDT and states no visit mapping.
issues.expected: SAP page 10: End of study will refer to the subject's Week 26 visit or early termination visit.
issues.observed: The specification's ADT fallback is ADSL.RFENDT, the RFENDTC conversion Define-XML ADTTE.ADT names. Pilot 6 adtte.r instead censors at the DS disposition date, or RFENDTC for a death.
issues.action: Confirm the censoring date is RFENDTC as Define-XML states (the adjudicator disputed this finding as context only), or document how the SAP end-of-study visit maps to ADT.

issues.title: First-event selection for ADT sorts missing dates and sequences last without a source
issues.summary: The specification's FIRST_DERM helper orders flagged ADAE records with nulls: last for ASTDT and AESEQ; no retained document says where missing keys sort.
issues.expected: The data guide (page 5) and Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL order the first occurrence by start date and sequence number; neither states where missing values go.
issues.observed: FIRST_DERM, which supplies the ADT event date, orders by ADAE.ASTDT and ADAE.AESEQ with nulls: last for both keys.
issues.action: Document the missing-key ordering for the first dermatologic event, or remove the choice from the specification if published AOCC01FL already settles it.

issues.title: Censoring flag depends on an undocumented missing-value sort order
issues.summary: CNSR uses the FIRST_DERM helper, which orders flagged ADAE records with nulls: last for ASTDT and AESEQ; no retained document states this ordering.
issues.expected: The data guide (page 5) and Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL order the first occurrence by start date and sequence number; neither states where missing values go.
issues.observed: CNSR is 0 when HAS_EVENT = 'Y', which is set from FIRST_DERM; FIRST_DERM orders by ADAE.ASTDT and ADAE.AESEQ with nulls: last for both keys.
issues.action: Document the missing-key ordering used to pick the event behind CNSR, or remove the choice from the specification if published AOCC01FL already settles it.

issues.title: Time-to-event origin read from TRTSDT instead of the documented RFSTDTC
issues.summary: Define-XML names ADSL.RFSTDTC as the source of STARTDT; the specification reads ADSL.TRTSDT. The two give the same dates in this data.
issues.observed: The specification derives STARTDT as ADSL.TRTSDT. Copying ADSL.RFSTDTC matches the reference STARTDT on all 254 records compared, so the difference is in the stated source, not the values.
issues.action: Decide which variable is the time-to-event origin and align the specification and the Define-XML comment on it.

issues.title: Source sequence is read directly instead of conditioned on SRCDOM = ADAE
issues.summary: Define-XML sets SRCSEQ to ADAE.AESEQ only when SRCDOM is ADAE and null otherwise; the specification reads FIRST_DERM.AESEQ with no SRCDOM condition.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.SRCSEQ: The value of ADAE.AESEQ if SRCDOM=ADAE, otherwise null.
issues.observed: The specification derives SRCSEQ as FIRST_DERM.AESEQ. Pilot 6 adtte.r sets SRCSEQ = AESEQ only in its event source, so censored records keep it missing.
issues.action: Confirm that SRCDOM is ADAE exactly when FIRST_DERM.AESEQ exists (the adjudicator disputed the finding on that ground), or state the SRCDOM condition in the specification.

issues.title: Source sequence depends on an undocumented missing-value sort order
issues.summary: SRCSEQ reads AESEQ from the FIRST_DERM helper, which orders flagged ADAE records with nulls: last for ASTDT and AESEQ; no retained document states this ordering.
issues.expected: The data guide (page 5) and Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL order the first occurrence by start date and sequence number; neither states where missing values go.
issues.observed: SRCSEQ is FIRST_DERM.AESEQ; FIRST_DERM orders by ADAE.ASTDT and ADAE.AESEQ with nulls: last for both keys.
issues.action: Document the missing-key ordering used to pick the source event, or remove the choice from the specification if published AOCC01FL already settles it.

issues.title: Source domain rule does not say which source applies when event and end dates coincide
issues.summary: Define-XML says SRCDOM names the source used for ADT (ADAE or ADSL) but gives no rule when the flagged ADAE.ASTDT and ADSL.RFENDT are the same date, so it cannot be checked as written.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.SRCDOM: The Source domain referred to in order to populate ADT (either ADAE or ADSL).
issues.observed: No complete rule could be stated as a probe. Pilot 6 adtte.r sets SRCDOM to ADAE in its event source and ADSL in its censoring source, so the label follows the source derive_param_tte chose.
issues.action: State SRCDOM as an explicit rule, for example ADAE when the record is an event (CNSR = 0) and ADSL otherwise, in the Define-XML comment and the specification.

issues.title: Source variable rule does not say which variable applies when event and end dates coincide
issues.summary: Define-XML says SRCVAR names the variable used for ADT (ASTDT or RFENDT) but gives no rule when the flagged ADAE.ASTDT and ADSL.RFENDT are the same date, so it cannot be checked as written.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.SRCVAR: The Source variable referred to in order to populate ADT (either ASTDT or RFENDT).
issues.observed: No complete rule could be stated as a probe. Pilot 6 adtte.r sets SRCVAR to ASTDT for events and RFENDT for censored records, though its censoring date is EOS2DT, not RFENDT.
issues.action: State SRCVAR as an explicit rule tied to the ADT branch actually taken, and make the censoring label match the censoring date variable.
